adaptations: The tested DLL is copied only in memory. StrategyController.SetArmy renders no scene; it attaches a managed fake ArmyController whose actual GetState returns Running.

MyPathfinding scene positions and waypoint routes use managed default vectors; GetCityIndex returns -1 because no rendered city transform exists. GetSiegeRouteLength/GetCampaignRouteLength use the test city graph with 30 units per edge. The real game city-neighbor graph is retained for the MOD13 diagnosis; fixture worlds use explicitly listed graphs. Android navigation, route geometry, travel timing and rendering are not executed.

Unity transform/gameObject/Destroy boundaries are null/default/no-op; Unity object comparisons become managed reference comparisons. Integer randomness is deterministic: zero for chance rolls, at most 3000 for money carried.

MonthAct, BuildFactionPlans, ExecuteStrategicPlans, full SetArmyMove, readiness/reserves, general movement, army creation, money transfer and full IntoTheCity merge otherwise run actual game bytecode. Test friendly travel is advanced between months by invoking actual IntoTheCity; enemy battles are not simulated.
